description: We are tenth-grade students who have been assigned this challenging space mission proposed by NASA. Our goal is to successfully complete the mission by applying our knowledge, working as a team, and making decisions that will help us overcome the different challenges we may face throughout the process.
summary: Our project is an Offline Smart Health Monitoring System designed to help astronauts monitor their health during long space missions. We developed a local dashboard that collects and displays health data, including heart rate, blood oxygen levels, and sleep patterns, using information exported from wearable devices such as the Apple Watch. This project is important because astronauts face many health challenges in space, especially due to microgravity. Our system provides a simple and reliable way to monitor their physical condition, detect possible health problems early, and support their safety and independence during deep-space missions.
details:
Our project allows astronauts to monitor their health without needing internet access. It helps them track heart rate, blood oxygen, and sleep patterns. It also provides quick access to important medical information. Its main goal is to keep astronauts safe and support their health during long space missions.

Tools, coding languages, hardware, or software used

  • Backend: Python, Flask, and Pandas.
  • Frontend: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Data visualization: Chart.js.
  • Data storage: Browser localStorage.
  • Hardware and data source: Apple Watch and Apple Health exports.

Our project is creative because it works completely offline, making it useful for deep-space missions where internet access may be limited. We focused on making the dashboard simple, organized, and easy to understand.

Note on Biometric Data Availability!! The system is programmed to display blood oxygen (SpO2) and sleep data, but these sections are empty in the current demo because the Apple Watch used did not record this information. If a compatible device provides this data, the system will automatically process and display it without needing any changes to the code.
